queries_run: HDD industry new capacity timeline 2026 2027 Seagate Western Digital Toshiba exabyte shipments
HDD supply discipline capex plan 2026 Seagate Western Digital capital expenditure
Seagate peers capacity expansion announcement 2026 Toshiba Western Digital HDD production increase

findings.claim: Seagate is expanding its HDD head facility in Bloomington, MN by almost 3X, from 11,000 sq ft of clean room space to 19,000 sq ft. The article says the added capacity is expected 12-18 months out, i.e. later 2027 or 2028.
findings.source: Yahoo Finance (Forbes/Tom Coughlin syndication), 'Hard Disk Drive Unit Shipments Could Grow To Support AI Workloads', https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/hard-disk-drive-unit-shipments-031628090.html

findings.claim: TDK announced increased HDD head production capacity in April 2026, to support demand from Toshiba and possibly other HDD makers.
findings.source: Yahoo Finance (Forbes/Tom Coughlin syndication), 'Hard Disk Drive Unit Shipments Could Grow To Support AI Workloads', https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/hard-disk-drive-unit-shipments-031628090.html

findings.claim: Seagate and Western Digital both prioritize raising storage capacity (exabyte) shipments over raising HDD unit volume. The article's unit-shipment scenarios: +1.2% from 2025 to 2026; about +11% over 2026-2030 (median); up to +30% over 2026-2030 (high case, tied to capacity expansion announcements).
findings.source: Yahoo Finance (Forbes/Tom Coughlin syndication), 'Hard Disk Drive Unit Shipments Could Grow To Support AI Workloads', https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/hard-disk-drive-unit-shipments-031628090.html

findings.claim: Seagate FY2026 capex was $569M, up from $265M the prior year, about 4.7% of revenue. The article gives no FY2027 capex guidance.
findings.source: XenoSpectrum, 'Seagate's Gross Margin Hits 52.7%, HDDs in the AI Era Earn Through Density, Not Unit Volume', https://xenospectrum.com/en/seagate-fy2026-hamr-margin/

findings.claim: Seagate nearline HDD supply allocations are largely filled through 2028, and customers are already discussing 2029 and later procurement. Cloud providers want to lock in capacity over several years rather than buy spot. The article says Seagate must meet demand through areal density rather than unit volume growth.
findings.source: XenoSpectrum, 'Seagate's Gross Margin Hits 52.7%, HDDs in the AI Era Earn Through Density, Not Unit Volume', https://xenospectrum.com/en/seagate-fy2026-hamr-margin/

cyclical_supply_discipline_capacity.note: Found no announcement of a new HDD assembly plant or unit-capacity addition by Seagate, WD or Toshiba; the only capacity additions found were head (component) facilities, Seagate Bloomington and TDK. The search snippet 'WD: substantially higher exabyte output does not require CapEx to add unit capacity' and WD Q4 FY2026 capex of $108M came from an X post (TheValueist) whose date could not be verified, so it is not included as a finding. The Toshiba capacity plan was not found. Two WebFetch calls used (Yahoo, XenoSpectrum); the Forbes 2026-08-09 page returned 403.
